notes.subject: אפדת
notes.rationale: Min bilong em i 'plating' o 'efod' (klos bilong pris) — JPS ritim 'covered with gold', YLT ritim 'ephod'.

notes.subject: bel bilong meri i gat sik
notes.rationale: דוה i min sik bilong meri (menstruasion) — tok i hat long Tok Pisin, em i min 'samting tambu, rausim'.

notes.subject: to Yisrael
notes.rationale: Tok direktl long ol man: 'yu bai tok long em, Go ausait'.

translation: Na bai yu mekim ⟨את⟩ ol kova bilong ol piksa kaerim bilong silva bilong yu i go nogut, na ⟨את⟩ ol plating bilong ol piksa was bilong gol bilong yu; bai yu skerim ol i go we, olsem bel bilong meri i gat sik; yu bai tok long em: Go ausait.
